name: Role-Play
description: Turn Convoro into a role-play forum: members create characters and post as them. Multi-character accounts, applications & claims, in-character boards, character sheets & dice, trackers, and a live shoutbox — a polished, free first-party extension.
author: Convoro

settings.label: Characters per member
settings.help: How many characters each member may create. Set to 0 for unlimited.

settings.label: Approve new characters automatically
settings.help: When off, new characters wait for staff approval. Review the queue and choose in-character boards at /rp/staff (staff only).

settings.label: Show the controlling account on character profiles
settings.help: Adds a “Played by” line to each character profile so members can see who is behind a character.
